newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian palm oil up on covering, Chicago's rise.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian palm oil up on covering, Chicago's rise.

text.p: Malaysian palm oil prices were higher at the opening, helped by a firmer Chicago soyoil futures close on Friday and renewed covering by refiners, traders said.
"There's still some covering activities going on. The market looks firm at the moment but I expect some profit-taking to set in," said one trader.
Traders said the market is awaiting the release of April 1-20 export data from cargo surveyor SGS later on Monday.
At 0335 GMT, third position July futures contract was up five ringgit at 1,267 ringgit ($505.59) a tonne.
